title: SEC filing to Excel - real application recording
summary: An agent demonstrates an analyst's SEC-to-Excel task in real applications: downloading a filing, copying its statement, entering twelve amounts and twenty-five formulas in desktop Excel, documenting source scope, and saving the draft.

corpus_relationship.note: Deliberately outside the v1 synthetic JSON baseline contract. This is a distinct real-application demonstration and must not be reported as an additional passed baseline or native scenario.
corpus_relationship.directory_naming: Placed under the _recordings container because scenarios/_shared/contract.py discover() (lines 335-357) rejects any industry child directory without scenario.json. The leading underscore is that loader's existing exclusion rule and it does not descend into the container, so the pilot coexists with the fifteen scenarios without editing shared code, without a scenario.json, and without inventing baseline cases.
corpus_relationship.test_discovery_note: run_tests.py separately includes nested financial-services recording-pilot tests. Corpus discovery remains unchanged, and ordinary tests require only the standard library.
